content: Dudweiler is a district located in Saarbrücken, a city in the Saarland state of southwestern Germany. It is situated near the French border and has a history dating back several centuries. Originally an independent municipality, Dudweiler was incorporated into Saarbrücken in 1974 during a municipal reform. The area has historically been associated with coal mining, which was an important economic activity in the region during the 19th and 20th centuries.
